Copilot is free with a signed-in Microsoft account

There's a free tier available with a signed-in Microsoft account. Some capabilities have usage limits, with more available on paid plans. With a Microsoft account, you can use Word, Excel, and PowerPoint in your browser for free. For desktop apps, more storage, and additional premium features, you can explore Microsoft 365 plans.
